title: Are you doing your homework?

before.predict: Look at the title. Where does Dilnoza do her homework?

text.title: An email to my cousin
paragraphs: Hi Sevara! How are you? I am writing this email at seven o'clock. I am not doing my **homework** right now — I am having a short break!

I usually do my **homework** in the **kitchen**, because my room is very cold. But today the kitchen is very **noisy**. My grandmother is cooking and my little brother is singing. It is not **quiet** at all! My grandmother gives me tea and bread while I work, so the kitchen is also the best place!

My mother always **helps** me with maths. She is good at numbers. My father helps me with English. Tonight I have maths, English and history. I want to **finish** before nine o'clock. He is only four years old and he sings the same song ten times every evening.
Where do you do your homework? Is your house **quiet**? Write soon! Maths is easy for me but history is difficult, because there are many dates.
